We have implemented the requested `EventListener.BatchDurable` event and DB durability wait/notify APIs on a new branch [`batch-durable`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2) branched from `main`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Write Options & Event Listener**:
   - Added [`CommitCorrelationID uint64`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/options.go#L411) to [`WriteOptions`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/options.go#L370).
   - Added [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/event.go#L920) struct containing `JobID`, `SeqNum`, `Err`, `ApplyDuration`, `SyncDuration`, `CorrelationID`, `BatchSize`, and `KeyCount`.
   - Added [`BatchDurable func(BatchDurableInfo)`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/event.go#L962) to [`EventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/event.go#L954).
   - Wired through [`EventListener.EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/event.go#L1075) and [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/event.go#L1258).

2. **Durability Manager & DB APIs**:
   - Implemented [`durabilityManager`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability.go#L79) managing FIFO ordering of durable commits, tracking highest durable sequence numbers, latching first errors, bounded job retention window, and bounded subscriptions.
   - Added the following methods to [`*DB`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability.go#L592-L668):
     - [`WaitForDurability(base.SeqNum) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability.go#L592) and [`WaitForDurabilityContext(context.Context, base.SeqNum) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability.go#L599) (seqnum zero succeeds after any commit; durability and close errors take precedence over context cancellation).
     - [`WaitForDurabilityBatch([]base.SeqNum) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability.go#L608) and [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(context.Context, []base.SeqNum) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability.go#L615) (nil or empty slice returns nil immediately).
     - [`WaitForJobDurability(int) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability.go#L625) and [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext(context.Context, int) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability.go#L633) (returns distinguishable `"expired"` error for evicted jobs, and `"unknown"` error for zero/negative or unseen IDs).
     - [`DurableState() (base.SeqNum, error)`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability.go#L641).
     - [`DurabilityNotify(base.SeqNum) <-chan error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability.go#L651) (pre-filled receive-only channel; bounded subscriptions returning an immediate non-nil error when limit is exceeded).
     - [`DurabilityStats() DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability.go#L663) (snapshot starting at zero values before commits; tracks `PendingWaiters` blocked in wait APIs).
   - Ensured all waiters and pending subscriptions unblock with error on DB close, and all wait/notify APIs return `nil` immediately when `DisableWAL` is true.

3. **Metrics**:
   - Added [`DurableCommitCount uint64`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/metrics.go#L384) and [`DurableCommitDuration time.Duration`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/metrics.go#L387) to [`Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/metrics.go#L358), accumulating WAL sync phase duration only when `BatchDurable` is configured.

4. **Tests & Git Commit**:
   - Added extensive unit tests in [`durability_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-n091_ax2/durability_test.go) covering all requirements and edge cases.
   - All tests pass cleanly, and changes are committed to branch `batch-durable`.
